lines.zh: 果酱从我的鳞缝里往外渗。
lines.en: Jam seeps out from between my scales.

lines.zh: 我游过的地方，水是甜的。
lines.en: The water turns sweet wherever I swim.

lines.zh: 我太黏了，水草老粘着我。
lines.en: I am too sticky; the weeds cling to me.

lines.zh: 身后跟着一串蜜蜂，它们想吃我。
lines.en: A line of bees trails me, hungry for my flavor.

lines.zh: 我游得慢，因为身体是果酱。
lines.en: I swim slowly, since my body is jam.

lines.zh: 河底的石头上，留着我紫色的印。
lines.en: Purple marks of mine stain the river stones.

lines.zh: 别让我靠岸，太阳会把我晒稠。
lines.en: Keep me from the bank; sun thickens me.

lines.zh: 我甩尾巴，甩出一小团甜雾。
lines.en: I flick my tail and throw off a sweet mist.

lines.zh: 我游进冷水，果酱才不会化。
lines.en: I swim into cold water so my jam stays firm.

lines.zh: 一条鱼该是什么味，我就是什么味。
lines.en: Whatever a fish should taste like, I am the opposite.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，鱼都躲得远。
lines.en: Where I pass, other fish keep their distance.

lines.zh: 我的鳍像两片抹开的果酱。
lines.en: My fins look like two smears of jam.

lines.zh: 河湾里那丛浆果，是我出生的地方。
lines.en: The berry patch in that bend is where I was born.

lines.zh: 别踩水里，你的靴子会变甜。
lines.en: Do not step in; your boots will turn sweet.

lines.zh: 我从荷叶底下游过，沾了一身绿。
lines.en: I swim under a lily pad and pick up green.

lines.zh: 水一凉，我就往深处挪一点。
lines.en: When the water cools, I move a little deeper.

lines.zh: 我泡在水里，像一罐没盖的果酱。
lines.en: I soak here like an open jar of jam.

lines.zh: 我的身体在慢慢滴，滴进河里。
lines.en: My body drips slowly, right into the river.

lines.zh: 一条鱼来舔我，被我黏住了。
lines.en: A fish licked me and got stuck fast.

lines.zh: 我数着水面的蜂影，一共七只。
lines.en: I count bee shadows above: seven of them.

lines.zh: 甜味招来了蚂蚁，它们在水上漂。
lines.en: Ants come for the sweetness, drifting on the surface.

lines.zh: 我把自己搅一搅，味道才匀。
lines.en: I stir myself so the flavor spreads evenly.

lines.zh: 水草根部的红，是我留下的。
lines.en: The red at the weed roots is my doing.

lines.zh: 别以为果酱鱼不会疼。
lines.en: Do not think a jamfish cannot feel pain.

lines.zh: 我在泥里蹭，想把多余的糖洗掉。
lines.en: I rub against mud to wash off extra sugar.

lines.zh: 那片水面发亮，是我的糖在结。
lines.en: That shining patch is my sugar crystallizing.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，吐出一颗没化的果粒。
lines.en: I open my mouth and spit out an unmelded berry.

lines.zh: 有人往河里倒了牛奶，我慌了。
lines.en: Someone poured milk in the river, and I panicked.

lines.zh: 我贴着一块凉石头，慢慢凝固。
lines.en: I press against a cool stone and slowly set.

lines.zh: 水面浮着一层薄甜，那是我。
lines.en: A thin sweet film floats up there; that is me.

lines.zh: 你盯着我看，像在看一罐果酱。
lines.en: You stare at me like a jar of jam on a shelf.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，眼睛是两颗果核。
lines.en: I look up, my eyes two small fruit pits.

lines.zh: 你咽了一下口水，我听见了。
lines.en: You swallowed; I heard it from down here.

lines.zh: 你手上沾着面包屑吗。
lines.en: Do you have breadcrumbs on your hands?

lines.zh: 别用那种眼神，我又不是早餐。
lines.en: Not that look; I am not breakfast.

lines.zh: 我从水下望你，你的脸在晃。
lines.en: I watch you from below, your face rippling.

lines.zh: 你要尝一口吗，就一口。
lines.en: Would you like a taste? Just one.

lines.zh: 我躲进紫色水草，还露着半边身。
lines.en: I hide in purple weeds, half of me still showing.

lines.zh: 你的影子甜不甜，我不知道。
lines.en: I do not know whether your shadow tastes sweet.

lines.zh: 别伸手，你会洗上三天。
lines.en: Do not reach in; you will wash for three days.

lines.zh: 我的身体裂了，甜水流出来。
lines.en: My body splits, and sweet water leaks out.

lines.zh: 疼，连我的糖都变苦了。
lines.en: It hurts so much even my sugar turns bitter.

lines.zh: 你打散了我一半的果酱。
lines.en: You knocked half my jam loose.

lines.zh: 我要走，游不快也要走。
lines.en: I am leaving, even if I can barely swim.

lines.zh: 伤口在水里散成粉色。
lines.en: The wound blooms pink in the water.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的味道全乱了。
lines.en: That hit scrambled my whole flavor.

lines.zh: 别追，我游得慢，你知道的。
lines.en: Do not chase; you know I swim slowly.

lines.zh: 我躲进石头缝，糖还在滴。
lines.en: I hide in a crack, still dripping sugar.

lines.zh: 水变浑了，我的甜被冲淡。
lines.en: The water muddies, and my sweetness thins.

lines.zh: 你打碎的那块，我不捡了。
lines.en: I will not pick up the piece you broke off.

lines.zh: 那颗浆果掉进水里，我冲过去了。
lines.en: A berry fell in, and I darted for it.

lines.zh: 是糖吗，是糖我就来。
lines.en: Is that sugar? If it is sugar, I am coming.

lines.zh: 你摇着罐子，我听见里面的响。
lines.en: You shake a jar; I hear what rattles inside.

lines.zh: 我闻到草莓味，鳃都张开了。
lines.en: I smell strawberry, and my gills flare open.

lines.zh: 我不咬钩，我只舔钩上的蜜。
lines.en: I do not bite the hook, only lick its honey.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我就前进半步。
lines.en: You step back once, and I advance half.

lines.zh: 那团面粉在水里散开了，好甜。
lines.en: That flour cloud in the water tastes wonderful.

lines.zh: 我靠近了，但你别动。
lines.en: I am coming closer, but you must stay still.

lines.zh: 果酱鱼最怕空钩子，也最馋。
lines.en: Jamfish fear bare hooks and crave them most.

lines.zh: 你把手放进水里，我就敢来。
lines.en: Put your hand in the water and I will dare.

lines.zh: 你踩下来，水里的甜味散开了。
lines.en: You step down, and sweetness spreads through the water.

lines.zh: 我被撞得晃，果酱荡出波纹。
lines.en: The bump rocks me, and jam ripples outward.

lines.zh: 别拿网兜顶我，我会粘上去。
lines.en: Do not push the net at me; I will stick.

lines.zh: 撞一下，你的靴子就归我了。
lines.en: One bump, and your boot belongs to me.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边绕，越绕越黏。
lines.en: I circle your feet, growing stickier each turn.

lines.zh: 水被搅浑了，我的甜味更浓。
lines.en: The water muddies, and my sweetness grows stronger.

lines.zh: 你踩到了我的尾巴，我甩不开。
lines.en: You stepped on my tail, and I cannot pull free.

lines.zh: 两个身体碰在一起，甜得发腻。
lines.en: Two bodies bump, and the sweetness turns cloying.

lines.zh: 我被挤出水面，又滑了回去。
lines.en: I am squeezed above water, then slide back down.

lines.zh: 别在这儿站太久，你会被粘住。
lines.en: Do not stand there long; you will stick.

lines.zh: 我要找一条同样甜的果酱鱼。
lines.en: I want a jamfish as sweet as I am.

lines.zh: 水底的浆果丛，是我们约好的地方。
lines.en: The berry thicket below is where we agreed.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，水变成粉红色。
lines.en: We swim side by side, and the water turns pink.

lines.zh: 她的味道像蓝莓，我更爱草莓。
lines.en: She tastes of blueberry; I prefer strawberry.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴碰她，那是我在问好。
lines.en: I touch her with my tail; that is my greeting.

lines.zh: 两条鱼黏在一起，分不开了。
lines.en: Two fish stuck together and cannot separate.

lines.zh: 小溪转弯处水浅，正好产卵。
lines.en: The shallow bend is just right for spawning.

lines.zh: 我把最甜的那块石头让给她。
lines.en: I give her the sweetest stone I have found.

lines.zh: 果酱鱼不求长久，只求同一片水。
lines.en: Jamfish ask only for the same water, not forever.

lines.zh: 小鱼一出生就带着甜味。
lines.en: The fry are born already carrying sweetness.

lines.zh: 那颗掉下来的果核，我要了。
lines.en: That fallen fruit pit is mine now.

lines.zh: 我顶着一片叶子，上面还有露水。
lines.en: I balance a leaf that still holds dew.

lines.zh: 糖块沉到河底，我抱住了。
lines.en: A sugar cube sank, and I clutched it.

lines.zh: 这块饼干在水里还没散。
lines.en: This biscuit has not dissolved yet.

lines.zh: 我把果皮收进石头缝里。
lines.en: I tuck fruit peel into a stone crack.

lines.zh: 谁丢的罐子，正好装得下我。
lines.en: Someone's lost jar happens to fit me.

lines.zh: 我不捡铁，铁会把甜味压住。
lines.en: I ignore iron; it flattens the sweetness.

lines.zh: 一勺蜂蜜沉下来，整条河都甜了。
lines.en: A spoonful of honey sank and sweetened the river.

lines.zh: 我把花瓣顶在头上，像一顶帽子。
lines.en: I wear a petal on my head like a hat.

lines.zh: 那块蛋糕太软，一碰就化了。
lines.en: That cake was too soft and melted at a touch.

lines.zh: 有东西在水边晃，带着甜味。
lines.en: Something sways at the water's edge, smelling sweet.

lines.zh: 那不是鱼，可比鱼有意思。
lines.en: That is no fish, but it is more interesting.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛盯住了那双靴子。
lines.en: My eyes have fixed on those boots.

lines.zh: 它一动，我的糖就化了。
lines.en: It moves, and my sugar starts melting.

lines.zh: 我在水下看到了影子，就跟着。
lines.en: I saw a shadow underwater and followed it.

lines.zh: 目标就在岸边，只差一步水。
lines.en: The target is at the bank, one step from water.

lines.zh: 我不想攻击，我只想靠近。
lines.en: I do not want to attack; I only want to be close.

lines.zh: 我慢慢浮上去，只露两只眼。
lines.en: I float up slowly, showing only two eyes.

lines.zh: 那个人在看我，我也在看他。
lines.en: That person watches me, and I watch back.

lines.zh: 我把目标记成一颗会走路的糖。
lines.en: I file the target as sugar that walks.

lines.zh: 我贴着他的脚游，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: I swim around his feet, circle after circle.

lines.zh: 他走一步，我的甜味就跟一步。
lines.en: Each step he takes, my sweetness follows.

lines.zh: 我在等他自己踩进水里。
lines.en: I am waiting for him to step in.

lines.zh: 这条腿是我的，我认领了。
lines.en: This leg is mine; I claim it.

lines.zh: 他蹲下来了，我屏住果酱。
lines.en: He crouches, and I hold my jam still.

lines.zh: 我的鳍在打拍子，等他靠近。
lines.en: My fins tap time, waiting for him.

lines.zh: 别往后退，后面是石头。
lines.en: Do not back away; there is stone behind you.

lines.zh: 目标不动了，那正好。
lines.en: The target has stopped, and that suits me.

lines.zh: 我把甜味收起来，免得被闻见。
lines.en: I hold my sweetness in so he cannot smell it.

lines.zh: 我在水底跟着他的倒影走。
lines.en: I follow his reflection along the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住脚踝，黏住了。
lines.en: I bite his ankle and stick fast.

lines.zh: 这一下不疼，是黏。
lines.en: This will not hurt; it will only cling.

lines.zh: 我把果酱抹在他鞋上。
lines.en: I smear jam across his shoe.

lines.zh: 他甩不掉我，我黏得很牢。
lines.en: He cannot shake me; I hold on tight.

lines.zh: 牙齿很小，但糖分很高。
lines.en: My teeth are small, but the sugar is strong.

lines.zh: 我撞他的小腿，软软的。
lines.en: I ram his shin, and it gives softly.

lines.zh: 这算攻击吗，我只想尝尝。
lines.en: Is this an attack? I only wanted a taste.

lines.zh: 我一咬，他整条河都甜了。
lines.en: I bite, and the whole river sweetens.

lines.zh: 越擦越糟，糖已经进布里了。
lines.en: Wiping makes it worse; the sugar soaked into the cloth.

lines.zh: 我打不过他，但我会粘住他。
lines.en: I cannot beat him, but I can stick to him.

lines.zh: 我从浆果丛下面的泥里浮上来。
lines.en: I float up from mud beneath the berry bush.

lines.zh: 刚出生，我浑身还在滴。
lines.en: Newly spawned, and still dripping everywhere.

lines.zh: 这水是甜的，应该是我的家。
lines.en: This water is sweet; it must be my home.

lines.zh: 我张开眼，看见一圈紫色。
lines.en: I open my eyes and see a ring of purple.

lines.zh: 出生的地方要有花，也要有水。
lines.en: I need flowers where I am born, and water.

lines.zh: 一只蜜蜂已经盯上我了。
lines.en: A bee has already set its sights on me.

lines.zh: 我试着游，果酱在身后散开。
lines.en: I try to swim, and jam trails behind me.

lines.zh: 这条河从今天起有甜味了。
lines.en: From today this river tastes of sugar.

lines.zh: 水面上的光，照得我发亮。
lines.en: Light on the surface makes me shine.

lines.zh: 我出生时，身边有一块碎糖。
lines.en: When I spawned, a shard of sugar lay beside me.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我整条鱼都在冒泡。
lines.en: The heat makes my whole body bubble.

lines.zh: 我摔在石头上，果酱糊了一片。
lines.en: I land on stone and smear jam everywhere.

lines.zh: 水太烫，我的鳃闭住了。
lines.en: The water is too hot, and my gills clamp shut.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，我的甜味被震散。
lines.en: An explosion scatters my sweetness into the water.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的身体，留下一串甜。
lines.en: An arrow passes through, leaving a trail of sweetness.

lines.zh: 紫色的光打下来，我开始凝固。
lines.en: Purple light strikes me, and I start to set.

lines.zh: 糖分耗光了，我身体塌下去。
lines.en: My sugar runs out, and my body sags inward.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面上，我的糖全焦了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the surface and burns all my sugar.

lines.zh: 水退了，我的甜味飘向黑处。
lines.en: The water drains, and my sweetness drifts into black.
